name: Simona Deleanu
source:
A prominent plastic surgeon in London. 

She contracts Robert to create new, better NDA Contracts for her plastic surgery clients to sign.

She needs these updated NDA's, not because Simona is a bad plastic surgeon, but because she tends to be quite blunt to everyone she talks to. 

This bluntness usually ends up unintentionally insulting her clients. Thus, the reason for the NDA's.

Simona is actually one of the best plastic surgeon's in the UK.
